verdict.rationale: Siskind Susser is an immigration firm, so the question of documenting an O-1-to-green-card path (EB-1A or EB-2 NIW) clearly applies. However, nothing in the evidence mentions EB-1A, EB-2 NIW, or any green-card continuation strategy for O-1 holders. The pack covers only the startup practice, the founders' book, O-3 dependents on the O-1 page, and AI-tool prompts about I-485/I-130 that are unrelated to employment-based self-petition strategy.
